name: Zero-Width Substitution by a Nonmonotone Path Test
definition: Take $C=T=\{000,001,011,111\}$ and substitute $T$ for the middle coordinate of $C$. The outer sections are $C_0=\{00,01\}$ and $C_1=\{01,11\}$; the test complement is $\{010,110,100,101\}$.
properties: The output has 16 concepts on five coordinates and admits a zero-width four-block order. The test and its complement are both four-vertex paths with zero-width orders. The test cannot become monotone under coordinate reflections because its induced graph is a path, whereas a four-vertex daisy induces either a square or a three-leaf star.
